records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue: Revenue decreased $95.7 million, or 40.6%, to $140.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2024 from $235.9 million for the three months ended September 30, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in cost of sales for the three months ended September 30, 2024 was primarily driven by decreased volumes.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in cost of sales for the nine months ended September 30, 2024 was primarily driven by approximately $105.8 million attributable to decreased volumes and $10.6 million in efficiencies in inventory management.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company incurred approximately $16.4 million in advertising expenses for the nine months ended September 30, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Income from operations: For the three months ended September 30, 2024, the Company’s income from operations was $2.1 million, a $23.4 million decrease from the $25.5 million income from operations for the corresponding period in 2023 primarily as a result of decreased gross profit partially offset by decreased SG&A expenses.
